evidence_boundaries.110Cd: Roy2011 Table 1 directly gives tau and B(E2), not a J2 table. Its E_gamma finite differences contain a negative 20-22 proxy and do not independently establish a 60-70 peak.
evidence_boundaries.104Pd: Rather2014 Table 1 reports J2/B(E2); multiplying by B(E2) gives a derived maximum about 63.5 hbar^2/MeV at I=20.
evidence_boundaries.pairing: Zhang2013/2019 support frequency-dependent PNC pairing, blocking and occupation rearrangement, but neither measures a Delta(omega) collapse in 110Cd.
evidence_boundaries.causality: The J2 peak follows here only after an explicit finite-response mapping from pair stiffness to J_core; it is a falsifiable mechanism control, not source-reported attribution.
